title_en: DUPLEX FOR SALE NEAR THE HILL OF THE SUN
description_en: Apartment/Duplex for sale in Residence Kodra e Diellit 1, one of the most sought after and quiet areas of Tirana. The apartment is located on the third/fourth floor of a new 4-story building and has a total area of ​​120.9 m2, organized in a very functional way. Organization: First floor Living room with kitchen area Corridor Toilet Balcony Second floor 2 bedrooms Toilet Balcony Storage The apartment is furnished in a modern style, with quality furnishings and ready for occupancy. Balconies offer green views and relaxing panoramas, ideal for peace and comfort. Possession document available. For a visit to the property, contact us
